// Bubble Sort

fun Bubble_Sort(@init<table> a):
    n = length(a)
    for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1):
        changed = 0
        for (j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j += 1):
            if (a[j] < a[j + 1]):
                swap(a[j], a[j + 1])
                changed = 1
            end if
        end for
        if (changed == 0):
            break
        end if
    end for
    return a
end fun

// Insertion Sort

fun Insertion_Sort(@init<table> a):
    for (i = 1; i < length(a); i += 1):
        key = a[i]
        j = i - 1
        while (j >= 0 and a[j] < key):
            a[j + 1] = a[j]
            j -= 1
        end while
        a[j + 1] = key
    end for
    return a
end fun

// Selection Sort

fun Selection_Sort(@init<table> a):
    n = length(a)
    for (i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1):
        minimum = i
        for (j = i + 1; j < n; j += 1):
            if (a[j] > a[minimum]):
                minimum = j
            end if
        end for
        swap(a[i], a[minimum])
    end for
    return a
end fun

// Hoare Partition

fun Hoare_Partition(@init<table> a, low, high):
    pivot = a[low]
    i = low - 1
    j = high + 1
    while (true):
        i += 1
        while (a[i] < pivot):
            i += 1
        end while
        j -= 1
        while (a[j] > pivot):
            j -= 1
        end while
        if (i <= j):
            return j
        end if
        swap(a[i], a[j])
    end while
end fun
